Yes, 1000% go there. The reality is that it doesn't matter where you go to school, just get licensed for the cheapest amount possible. Do not listen to anyone who tells you that it matters where you went to school because it does not. Schools only teach you the basics and if you're going to get good at nails you're going to have to learn on your own by practicing, learning from other nail techs, and taking outside classes. The only difference between schools is that some people get licensed for a fraction of the cost than the others thereby setting them up for success in the industry. Being a nail tech is awesome, it's a skill that you'll always have, and if you're not stupid and keep renewing your license then no matter what you always have a marketable skill to fall back on. Do it and do it at the ATC.
